summary.zh: 多模型供应商路由、自动容灾切换、SSE 流式传输、用量计量与边缘缓存。

title.zh: 生产级可靠性与评测体系

summary.zh: 离线回归评测集、实时链路追踪、幂等任务队列与零停机数据库迁移。

role.zh: 资深 AI 系统工程师

summary.en: Architected the company-wide Agent Runtime and multi-provider LLM Gateway serving 40M+ monthly requests with 99.95% availability.
summary.zh: 主导公司级 Agent 运行时与多模型网关架构，稳定支撑月均 4000 万+ 请求，可用性达 99.95%。

summary.en: Led real-time SQL copilot and collaborative notebook features in TypeScript, React, and Python; reduced query authoring time by 52%.
summary.zh: 主导实时 SQL 副驾驶与协作式 Notebook 研发，帮助分析师平均缩短 52% 的查询编写时间。

summary.en: Built idempotent settlement pipelines, automated regression harnesses, and anomaly detection alerts across high-throughput payment services.
summary.zh: 负责高吞吐支付清算幂等流水线、自动化回归测试框架与异常告警系统建设。

title.zh: Pulse 智能体运行时与并发锁引擎

role.en: Lead Architect · Python / FastAPI / Redis / React
role.zh: 首席架构师 · Python / FastAPI / Redis / React

summary.en: A resumable multi-step Agent execution engine with tool sandboxing, optimistic state locks, and live SSE trace streaming.
summary.zh: 支持断点续跑的多步 Agent 执行引擎，内置工具沙箱、乐观状态锁与实时 SSE 追踪流。

outcome.en: Cut failed multi-turn tool runs by 64% while enabling safe human-agent co-editing.
outcome.zh: 将多轮工具调用失败率降低 64%，并实现了安全的人机协同编辑。

title.en: Long-running agents silently corrupted shared workspaces
title.zh: 长耗时 Agent 静默破坏共享工作区状态

body.en: When users edited documents while an agent executed multi-step tool calls, race conditions caused lost updates and broken references.
body.zh: 当用户在 Agent 执行多步工具调用期间同时编辑文档时，竞态条件会导致更新丢失与引用损坏。

items.en: Introduced scoped execution locks with automatic lease expiry and clean rollback.
items.zh: 引入带自动租约过期与回滚机制的作用域执行锁。

items.en: Streamed every tool input, output, and latency span to the UI via Redis Streams + SSE.
items.zh: 通过 Redis Streams + SSE 将每次工具输入、输出与耗时实时推送到前端。

title.en: Deterministic replay and automated load testing
title.zh: 确定性回放与自动化压测验证

body.en: Every tool schema is validated at boundaries and replayed against a 90-case regression suite before release.
body.zh: 所有工具 Schema 在边界严格校验，并在每次发布前跑通 90 个场景的确定性回归集。

text.en: Acquire workspace lease and validate tool arguments against strict JSON schemas.
text.zh: 获取工作区租约锁，并按严格 JSON Schema 校验工具参数。

text.en: Run sandboxed tools with retry policies and push live trace events over SSE.
text.zh: 在沙箱中带重试策略执行工具，并通过 SSE 实时推送轨迹。

text.en: Persist incremental state diffs atomically and release the execution lock.
text.zh: 原子化落盘增量状态变更，并安全释放执行锁。

title.zh: Mesh 多供应商大模型网关

role.en: System Owner · Cloudflare Workers / TypeScript / Go
role.zh: 系统负责人 · Cloudflare Workers / TypeScript / Go

summary.en: Unified OpenAI-compatible routing layer with circuit breakers, automatic region failover, and per-tenant budget caps.
summary.zh: 统一的 OpenAI 兼容路由层，提供熔断器、跨区域自动容灾与多租户预算配额管控。

outcome.en: 99.95% uptime across 4 model providers with 31% lower blended token cost.
outcome.zh: 横跨 4 家模型供应商实现 99.95% 可用性，综合 Token 成本降低 31%。

title.zh: 消除单一模型厂商故障带来的业务中断

body.en: Built health-scored routing tables that shift traffic within 200ms whenever an upstream provider returns 429 or 5xx errors.
body.zh: 构建基于健康分的动态路由表，当上游返回 429 或 5xx 时在 200ms 内完成无感切流。

text.en: Verify tenant key and enforce per-minute token and spend budgets at the edge.
text.zh: 在边缘节点校验租户密钥并执行分钟级 Token 与费用限额。

text.en: Select the healthiest provider by latency and automatically fall back on transient errors.
text.zh: 按延迟选择最优供应商，遇到瞬时故障自动切至备用通道。

summary.en: Side-by-side LLM diff workbench that turns production chat logs into repeatable CI assertions.
summary.zh: 支持并排对比的大模型评测工作台，把线上真实对话一键转化为可复用的 CI 断言。

outcome.en: Adopted by 12 internal product teams, catching 100% of schema regressions before deploy.
outcome.zh: 被 12 个内部产品团队采用，上线前拦截 100% 的结构化输出回归问题。

title.en: Make prompt changes as reviewable as code PRs
title.zh: 让 Prompt 改动像代码 PR 一样可审查

body.en: Engineers inspect exact rubric scores, latency deltas, and cost changes in one clean diff view before merging.
body.zh: 工程师在合并前即可在同一视图查看精确评分、延迟变化与成本差异。

text.en: Promote edge-case production chats into anonymized golden datasets.
text.zh: 将线上边界案例一键脱敏并沉淀为黄金评测集。

text.en: Run deterministic JSON and rubric checks on every pull request.
text.zh: 每次提交 PR 自动执行结构化校验与质量评分门禁。
